faq: Will upgrading Flutter break my app?
Upgrades can break things, which is why we do it on a branch, fix errors one by one and test on both platforms before handing over. You can compare before and after, and roll back if you wish.
What if a plugin is no longer maintained?
We list it, update what is safe and suggest alternatives. Replacing a plugin used across the app can be a bigger job, so we price it before starting.
No. It is a fixed starter sprint with a clear end. If you want regular upkeep afterwards, we quote that separately based on how much your app needs.
Can you upload the new version to the stores?
We prepare signed builds and release notes. With limited access to your App Store Connect and Play Console, we can upload them for you. Your signing keys and accounts stay yours.
